title: Nose to brain delivery of dapoxetine-loaded PLGA nanoparticle for treatment of premature ejaculation distress in normal and diabetic rats with in silico targeting brain FOX and serotonin proteins.
authors: El-Ela, Fatma I Abo; Salem, Heba F; Nafady, Mohamed M; Kharshoum, Rasha M; Farouk, Hanan O
one_liner_zh: 该文研究达泊西汀PLGA纳米粒经鼻给药治疗早泄，涉及脑FOS和血清素蛋白的分子对接，但核心是药物递送与疾病治疗，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Psychological and emotional sexual conditions in men include premature ejaculation. Premature Ejaculation (PE) has 4%-66% worldwide effects on self-esteem, relationships, and quality of life. Poor sexual confidence, anxiety, and sadness may worsen the issue. For this disease, dapoxetine HCl (DH) is used. In normal and streptozotocin (STZ)-induced diabetic rats, DH-loaded poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid) PLGA NP intranasal (IN) therapy was compared to standard lidocaine for DH release, entrapment efficiency, behavioural analysis, histopathological and immunohistochemistry expression, as neuroprotection inspection and proto-oncogene c-Fos (FOS) protein sequence expression. Also, in silico brain serotonin and FOS protein analyses were performed. Double-emulsion-solvent evaporation produced DH-loaded PLGA NP for IN quick-acting PE. Safe, controlled release, and effectiveness were investigated in PE rats using DH-PLGA NP. The brain's FOS protein expression, mount, intromission, post-ejaculatory, and Ejaculation frequencies were estimated. Optimized spherical NPs were 174 nm in size, - 69.45 mV zeta potential, 98.04% entrapment efficiency, and 78.61% release after 8 h. The brain's ejaculation centre's rapid-acting DH prolongs intra-ejaculation, lowers FOS protein density, and normalizes hippocampus neurons. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed behavioural results of lower FOS protein expression and delayed ejaculation. Docking revealed that the DH ligand binds more strongly to brain protein active sites involved in premature ejaculation via rapid brain delivery bypassing the BBB via IN dosing, confirmed by behavioural analysis, histopathology, and immunohistochemistry. Using DH acutely decreased rapid ejaculation and changed contextual neuronal activity in ejaculatory network brain regions. Our results improve PE neurobiology and pharmacology research. Expression of FOS protein in DH nanoformula IN protects normal and diabetic rats in normal and diabetic premature ejaculated rats.
abstract_zh: 男性心理和情感性状况包括早泄。早泄（Premature Ejaculation, PE）在全球范围内影响4%-66%的自尊、人际关系和生活质量。性自信不足、焦虑和悲伤可能加剧该问题。针对此疾病，使用盐酸达泊西汀（dapoxetine HCl, DH）。在正常和链脲佐菌素（streptozotocin, STZ）诱导的糖尿病大鼠中，将载DH的聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物（poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid), PLGA）纳米粒（NP）经鼻内（intranasal, IN）给药与标准利多卡因进行比较，评估DH释放、包封效率、行为学分析、组织病理学和免疫组织化学表达，作为神经保护检查及原癌基因c-Fos（FOS）蛋白序列表达。此外，进行了计算机模拟脑血清素和FOS蛋白分析。采用双乳液-溶剂蒸发法制备载DH的PLGA NP，用于IN速效治疗PE。在PE大鼠中研究了DH-PLGA NP的安全性、控制释放和有效性。估算了脑内FOS蛋白表达、爬跨、插入、射精后和射精频率。优化后的球形NPs大小为174 nm，zeta电位为-69.45 mV，包封效率为98.04%，8小时后释放率为78.61%。脑射精中心的速效DH延长了射精间隔，降低了FOS蛋白密度，并使海马神经元正常化。组织学和免疫组织化学证实了行为学结果，即FOS蛋白表达降低和射精延迟。分子对接显示，DH配体通过IN给药绕过血脑屏障（BBB）快速递送至脑，与参与早泄的脑蛋白活性位点结合更强，这通过行为学分析、组织病理学和免疫组织化学得到证实。使用DH急性降低了快速射精，并改变了射精网络脑区中的情境性神经元活动。我们的结果推进了PE神经生物学和药理学研究。DH纳米制剂IN中FOS蛋白表达在正常和糖尿病早泄大鼠中具有保护作用。
